annotations.title: Disable auto-publish for an issue type

description: Patches: stops auto-publishing freshly AI-drafted patches for this issue type — future drafts wait for a manual publish_patch call again. Already-published patches are unaffected. FREE (no credits), but this is a MUTATION. Requires an org admin.

issueType.description: Which issue type's auto-publish rule to remove.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: disable_patch_auto_publish
